meta.name: product-changelog
meta.description: Product changelog and release notes that users actually read. Covers categorization, user-facing language, visuals, and distribution. Use for: release notes, changelogs, product updates, feature announcements, versioning. Triggers: changelog, release notes, product update, version notes, what's new, feature announcement, product changelog, update log, release announcement, version release, product release, ship notes

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 写出用户爱看的版本更新说明
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要让用户清楚了解每次产品更新的内容
copy.tagline_en: Write release notes that users actually read
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to communicate product updates clearly to users

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你撰写用户友好的产品更新日志，包括分类、版本号、视觉元素和发布渠道建议。
howto.when: 当你提到“更新日志”、“发布说明”、“产品更新”等关键词，或要求写版本更新内容时触发。

say.text: 帮我写本周的产品更新日志。
say.note: Claude 会按分类（新功能、改进、修复）组织内容。

say.text: 为这次发布写一条社交媒体的预告。
say.note: Claude 会生成带标题、描述和链接的格式。

say.text: 这个新功能需要加一张截图。
say.note: Claude 会建议生成视觉素材的命令。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you write user-friendly product changelogs and release notes, covering categorization, versioning, visuals, and distribution channels.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like 'changelog', 'release notes', 'product update', or ask to write version update content.

say_en.text: Write this week's product changelog for me.
say_en.note: Claude will organize entries by category (New, Improved, Fixed).

say_en.text: Create a social media snippet for this release.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a format with title, description, and link.

say_en.text: I need a screenshot for this new feature.
say_en.note: Claude will suggest commands to generate visuals.
